title: Window III
medium: White monochrome with string sewn directly onto canvas (museum description)
notes: Centre Pompidou curator Jean-Pierre Criqui explicitly describes Window III as a white monochrome whose lines are string sewn onto canvas. Exact Foundation EK 2 identity and observed cord arrangement are supplied by its separately captioned colour installation photo. The article discusses 1949 but no isolated creation-date caption was transcribed; date and dimensions remain unresolved here. Very pale SVG lines indicate the shadows of white cords, not gray pigment.
